claims.question: Whether the combination of MEMPOOL_NO_BROADCAST on wallet loading and MEMPOOL_AND_BROADCAST_ADDED on rebroadcast could prevent a transaction from being resubmitted if the node was offline during a mempool spike that purged the transaction from the network
